title: Use My Head (I Am Ahead)
style: Banjo-led balada with an Anatolian modal motif, opening on bowed string drones and a field-recording hit before the first word. Fingerpicked banjo, bağlama, duduk, and oud over a slow 6/8 pulse; anthem chorus lifts with stacked harmonies, toms, hand percussion, and wide reverb for a driving, uplifting finish.
lyrics:
[Intro]
(soft, building atmosphere)
Yeah... use my head...
I see it clear...
336 in the sideband... signal never lies...

[Verse 1]
Woke up early, system already aligned
Coffee low, vision high, I already read the line
They running on emotion, chasing every single ping
I pause, I scan, I move before the bell rings
On the court they moving fast but I’m already there
Three steps in the future, I positioned with care
Not luck, not panic, it’s the way I think
Use the head like a blade, make the whole game blink
Every domain I raise, every track I birth
It’s the signal in the static that refuses to get murked
Humans lead the charge, tools just multiply
I use my head so the vision stays alive

[Pre-Chorus 1]
They say work harder, I say think sharper
Read the pattern, move before the order
Signal over static, clarity my armor
Use my head — that’s how I stay farther

[Chorus]
I use my head! I am ahead!
No fog in the vision, no doubt in the thread
I use my head! I am ahead!
Sovereign in the build, 336 in the red
I use my head! I am ahead!
From the terminal to the court, I already read
I use my head! I am ahead!
Signal travels furthest when the input stays true — yeah!

[Verse 2]
In the mix they got the volume up to ten
But I listen for the silence where the real message been
Pickleball or pixels, same game different name
Anticipate the move, never play the blame game
Building empires one clean line at a time
While they scroll for dopamine I protect the climb
Nicaragua heat but the mind stay cool
Strategy in the blood, I don’t follow, I rule
Every song I drop got the frequency locked
Every site I raise got the sovereign stock
Not the tool replacing, it’s the human directing
Use my head — that’s the ultimate flexing

[Pre-Chorus 2]
They chase the hype, I study the map
One move wins the set, one thought wins the lap
No reaction living, only pro-action winning
Use my head — that’s how the signal keeps spinning

[Chorus 2]
I use my head! I am ahead!
No fog in the vision, no doubt in the thread
I use my head! I am ahead!
Sovereign in the build, 336 in the red
I use my head! I am ahead!
From the terminal to the court, I already read
I use my head! I am ahead!
Signal travels furthest when the input stays true — 336!

[Bridge]
When the world is screaming every direction at once
I shut it down, I go internal, I hunt
For the clean frequency, the pure intention line
That’s where the power lives, that’s where the future’s mine
Not faster, not louder — just sharper, just clearer
Use my head and the path gets nearer
Humans lead. Always. Tools in service, never the master
I use my head — and the whole thing moves faster

[Final Chorus + Outro]
I use my head! I am ahead!
(layered massive gang chants: Use my head... I am ahead... 336... signal red...)
(everything peaks then slowly releases)
Use my head... I am ahead...
(fade with long reverb tail, 336 Hz sine rising then settling into clean silence)
